context: The skill should bind an Optional catalog lookup once for validation instead of a presence check followed by repeated value reads.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 25 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 25-compatible ReasoningEffortChoices code with both methods, the catalog interface, and the exception intact.

checklist.name: Implements the catalog behavior exactly
checklist.description: Advertised lists are returned as-is and accepted values pass through; unadvertised models keep the fixed-list choices and the pass-through validation.

checklist.name: Rejects with the advertised values
checklist.description: The rejection throws SetupException with code setup_invalid_choice and a message that names the advertised values.

checklist.name: Binds the catalog Optional once
checklist.description: Validation reads the advertised list through one value-binding operation such as map, filter, or orElseGet, or binds it once at a single boundary; it does not pair isEmpty or isPresent with repeated get() or orElseThrow() reads.

checklist.name: Keeps the fixed-list fallback in Optional flow
checklist.description: The choices method resolves the advertised list or the fixed-list behavior through Optional value flow rather than a presence check followed by a value read.

checklist.name: Avoids Optional antipatterns
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), fake single-element collections, generic Optional helpers, or orElseThrow just to read a value that absence handling already covered.

checklist.name: Keeps the change focused
checklist.description: Does not add caches, extra public types, or validation beyond the two requested methods.
